lines.zh: 壳体贴着岩面一点点挪，像在爬
lines.en: Shell pressed to rock, it inches forward like a slow crawl.

lines.zh: 矿点在上，走起来一晃一晃
lines.en: The mineral on its back wobbles with every tiny step.

lines.zh: 沿着矿脉边缘，它慢慢往暗处移
lines.en: It drifts along the ore seam, sliding deeper into shadow.

lines.zh: 软足吸住石头，挪一步要歇很久
lines.en: Its soft foot grips the stone, and each step ends in a long rest.

lines.zh: 走过的地方只留下一道浅浅水痕
lines.en: Behind it, a thin wet trail glistens on the stone.

lines.zh: 壳里的青金石随着步伐轻轻响
lines.en: The lapis in its shell taps softly with each movement.

lines.zh: 它挑最黑的那块深板岩走
lines.en: It picks the darkest patch of deepslate to cross.

lines.zh: 爬到石缝里，整只都缩了进去
lines.en: It squeezes into a crack until the whole shell disappears.

lines.zh: 一路磨着花岗岩，壳沿都磨圆了
lines.en: Years of scraping granite have worn its shell rim round.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪向没有一丝光的角落
lines.en: It creeps toward a corner where no light reaches.

lines.zh: 背着绿宝石走路，显得格外小心
lines.en: Carrying an emerald, it moves with extra care.

lines.zh: 顺着安山岩的纹理一路往下蹭
lines.en: It slides down, following the grain of the andesite.

lines.zh: 壳上一粒紫水晶在黑暗里发微光
lines.en: A fleck of amethyst glimmers faintly on its shell.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，像块被遗忘的矿石
lines.en: It holds so still it looks like forgotten ore.

lines.zh: 悄悄张开壳缝，又迅速合上
lines.en: It opens a sliver of shell, then snaps it shut.

lines.zh: 吸盘在石面上轻轻起伏呼吸
lines.en: Its suction foot rises and falls with slow breathing.

lines.zh: 一整天只等着矿物重新长出来
lines.en: All day it simply waits for its mineral to regrow.

lines.zh: 壳纹一圈圈，记着换过几次矿
lines.en: Rings on the shell record every mineral it has worn.

lines.zh: 听到滴水声，它就往石壁里贴
lines.en: At the sound of dripping, it presses flat to the wall.

lines.zh: 石缝里传出一声极轻的咕噜
lines.en: A tiny gurgle rises from somewhere inside the crack.

lines.zh: 含着湿气的软体在壳里缓缓翻身
lines.en: Its damp body turns slowly inside the shell.

lines.zh: 它把煤壳对准无光的深处
lines.en: It angles its coal-studded shell toward the dark.

lines.zh: 钻石那面朝上，接着火把的余光
lines.en: The diamond side faces up, catching the torch's edge of light.

lines.zh: 壳沿挂着一层薄薄的湿苔
lines.en: A thin film of wet moss clings to its rim.

lines.zh: 它先探出触角，又缩回壳中
lines.en: It extends a feeler, then pulls it back inside.

lines.zh: 深处的石头冷得让它睡得更久
lines.en: The deep stone is cold enough to lengthen its sleep.

lines.zh: 我把壳正对着最暗的角落
lines.en: I turn my shell to the darkest corner

lines.zh: 矿物又厚了一丝，我等得起
lines.en: The mineral is a hair thicker; I can wait

lines.zh: 一滴水沿着壳顶滚下去
lines.en: A drop of water rolls off the top of my shell

lines.zh: 我缩着，听石头自己开裂
lines.en: I stay curled and listen to the stone crack

lines.zh: 察觉火光，它立刻把壳转向石壁
lines.en: Sensing torchlight, it turns its shell to the wall.

lines.zh: 从壳沿下偷看你，眼睛细得像缝
lines.en: It peeks from under the rim through slit-thin eyes.

lines.zh: 你的镐声让它整只贴紧了石头
lines.en: The sound of your pickaxe makes it cling tighter.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的镐，壳上宝石缩了一下
lines.en: Watching your pick, it retracts the gems on its shell.

lines.zh: 月光下它把你认成另一块石头
lines.en: Under moonlight it mistakes you for another boulder.

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，它就往暗处退半寸
lines.en: You step closer, and it retreats half an inch into shadow.

lines.zh: 它抬起软足，像在衡量该不该怕你
lines.en: It lifts its foot as if weighing whether to fear you.

lines.zh: 眼睛缩在壳下，一眨也不眨地看
lines.en: Eyes tucked beneath the shell, it stares without blinking.

lines.zh: 你手里的铁镐让它整个缩成一团
lines.en: The iron pickaxe in your hand makes it curl up whole.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转过来，壳上的煤亮了一下
lines.en: It turns slowly, and the coal on its back glints.

lines.zh: 它似乎认得镐头敲击的节奏
lines.en: It seems to know the rhythm of a pickaxe head.

lines.zh: 它探头看你的靴子，又缩了回去
lines.en: It peeks at your boots, then draws itself back in.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，它把整片壳都张开了
lines.en: When you crouch, it opens its shell wider than usual.

lines.zh: 它盯了你很久，才确认你不是矿
lines.en: It stares a long while before deciding you are no ore.

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮，我只好眯着眼
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright; I can only squint

lines.zh: 你蹲了很久，我数你的呼吸
lines.en: You crouch a long while; I count your breaths

lines.zh: 壳上多了一道白痕，它缩得更紧
lines.en: A white scratch appears on its shell; it draws in tighter.

lines.zh: 被敲中时，矿物在壳里乱响
lines.en: Struck, the minerals rattle around inside its shell.

lines.zh: 它没有叫，只是软足猛吸了一下
lines.en: It makes no cry, only clamps its foot down hard.

lines.zh: 壳沿冒出一线湿气，像在发抖
lines.en: A thread of damp air leaks from its rim.

lines.zh: 每挨一下，它都往石头里挤一点
lines.en: With every hit, it presses a bit deeper into the stone.

lines.zh: 它把最硬的宝石那面翻了过来
lines.en: It turns the hardest jeweled side of its shell upward.

lines.zh: 伤害让它渗出一点透明黏液
lines.en: The damage makes it seep a little clear slime.

lines.zh: 壳裂了细缝，它久久不肯张开
lines.en: A hairline crack opens, and it will not open up again.

lines.zh: 它把自己吸在地上，拖都拖不动
lines.en: It suctions to the ground and refuses to be dragged.

lines.zh: 那一击之后，它的触角全收了
lines.en: After that blow, all its feelers retract.

lines.zh: 你放下的圆石，让它慢慢伸出了足
lines.en: The cobblestone you set down draws out its foot.

lines.zh: 一块深板岩就让它挪了半个身位
lines.en: One piece of deepslate moves it half a body length.

lines.zh: 它对着你手里的矿石嗅了嗅
lines.en: It sniffs at the raw ore in your hand.

lines.zh: 青金石的气味比光更能引它过来
lines.en: The smell of lapis pulls it closer than light does.

lines.zh: 你把火把移开，它才肯往前挪
lines.en: Move the torch away and it will finally advance.

lines.zh: 它蹭到你脚边的石块上，不走了
lines.en: It settles onto the stone by your feet and stays.

lines.zh: 一块带苔的石头换来它缓慢靠近
lines.en: A mossy stone buys its slow approach.

lines.zh: 它试了试紫水晶块，又缩回壳里
lines.en: It tests the amethyst block, then withdraws.

lines.zh: 你点亮火把，它立刻对石头失去兴趣
lines.en: Light your torch and its interest in the stone vanishes.

lines.zh: 它把壳贴在你给的矿石上蹭了蹭
lines.en: It rubs its shell against the ore you offered.

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，它整只缩进壳里
lines.en: Bumped once, it pulls its whole body inside.

lines.zh: 壳沿磕到你的靴子，发出一声闷响
lines.en: Its rim knocks your boot with a dull clack.

lines.zh: 它高举壳沿，笨拙地绕开你
lines.en: It lifts its rim and clumsily edges around you.

lines.zh: 撞击让它背上的矿物叮当作响
lines.en: The knock sets the minerals on its back jingling.

lines.zh: 它滑开了半步，留下一道湿印
lines.en: It slides half a step away, leaving a wet smear.

lines.zh: 软足打滑，壳在石头上转了一圈
lines.en: Its foot slips, and the shell spins on the stone.

lines.zh: 触碰之后，它固执地挪向更黑的石缝
lines.en: After the bump it stubbornly heads for a darker crack.

lines.zh: 它没生气，只是把壳合得更紧
lines.en: It is not angry, just sealing its shell tighter.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得它停下好一会
lines.en: Your footsteps shake it into a long pause.

lines.zh: 它慢慢让开一小块石面给你
lines.en: It slowly yields a small patch of stone to you.

lines.zh: 两只壳贴在一起，矿物轻轻相碰
lines.en: Two shells meet, their minerals tapping softly.

lines.zh: 它挑了一块最平的石头等另一半
lines.en: It picks the flattest stone and waits for a partner.

lines.zh: 一对矿壳贝并排吸在洞壁上
lines.en: A pair of limpets clings side by side to the cave wall.

lines.zh: 它们把壳纹对齐，像在交换暗号
lines.en: They line up their shell rings as if trading signals.

lines.zh: 交配时它一动不动，怕惊动对方
lines.en: It stays perfectly still, afraid of startling its mate.

lines.zh: 两只壳间流下一线细细的水
lines.en: A thin line of water runs between the two shells.

lines.zh: 它为同伴清出一块干净的石面
lines.en: It clears a clean patch of stone for its companion.

lines.zh: 壳与壳的缝隙里传出轻微的咕声
lines.en: A faint gurgle sounds from the gap between their shells.

lines.zh: 一对绿宝石壳在黑暗里慢慢靠拢
lines.en: Two emerald shells drift together in the dark.

lines.zh: 它的触角碰到另一只，便安静下来
lines.en: Its feeler meets another's, and it goes quiet.

lines.zh: 掉落的矿石就在旁边，它却不管
lines.en: Dropped ore lies beside it, and it pays no mind.

lines.zh: 它只吃石面上的薄苔，不捡东西
lines.en: It only grazes thin moss and never picks anything up.

lines.zh: 有东西落在壳上，它抖了抖
lines.en: Something lands on its shell; it gives a small shake.

lines.zh: 一块铁锭滚到足边，它绕了过去
lines.en: An iron ingot rolls to its foot; it slides around it.

lines.zh: 它没有手，只能用壳把杂物顶开
lines.en: With no hands, it nudges debris away with its shell.

lines.zh: 地上的碎矿对它毫无吸引力
lines.en: Scattered ore shards on the ground mean nothing to it.

lines.zh: 它把掉落物当成石头，直接压上去
lines.en: It treats the dropped item as stone and settles on it.

lines.zh: 你扔出的物品只是让它缩了下壳
lines.en: Your tossed item only makes it withdraw its shell.

lines.zh: 它慢慢爬过一堆箭矢，看都不看
lines.en: It crawls past a pile of arrows without a glance.

lines.zh: 壳下的软足只为攀附石头而生
lines.en: The foot beneath its shell exists only to grip rock.

lines.zh: 它锁定了你脚边那块发亮的矿石
lines.en: Its attention locks on the bright ore by your feet.

lines.zh: 一块露天的青金石让它停了下来
lines.en: An exposed lapis vein brings it to a halt.

lines.zh: 它把石头认成同类，凑过去查看
lines.en: It takes the stone for kin and goes to inspect it.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，它的触角全伸出来
lines.en: Something moves, and every feeler extends at once.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转向声音传来的方向
lines.en: It turns slowly toward the direction of the sound.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了石头，它的注意力被吸走
lines.en: You crack a stone, and its focus snaps there.

lines.zh: 它不去追击，只是盯住那块矿脉
lines.en: It does not chase; it just watches the ore seam.

lines.zh: 壳上的矿物顺着一道光转了过去
lines.en: The minerals on its shell swing toward a beam of light.

lines.zh: 它把落下的碎石当成了什么宝贝
lines.en: It mistakes the falling rubble for something precious.

lines.zh: 洞口的风吹来矿尘，它抬眼看去
lines.en: Ore dust blows in from the cave mouth, and it looks up.

lines.zh: 它沿着石壁跟着你，慢得几乎不动
lines.en: It trails you along the wall, barely moving.

lines.zh: 你走远了，它还朝那个方向挪
lines.en: You are far off, and it still creeps that way.

lines.zh: 它一路吸着石头，落在你身后三步
lines.en: Clinging to stone, it falls three steps behind you.

lines.zh: 追不上就爬上洞顶，从上面看你
lines.en: Unable to catch up, it climbs the ceiling to watch.

lines.zh: 它把壳上的宝石对准你的火把
lines.en: It aims the gems on its shell at your torch.

lines.zh: 它认准了你的矿镐，一直跟着
lines.en: It has fixed on your pickaxe and keeps following.

lines.zh: 隔着石柱，它一点点绕过来
lines.en: Behind the stone pillar, it works its way around.

lines.zh: 它停下来重新判断声音的方向
lines.en: It halts to reconsider where the sound came from.

lines.zh: 追踪途中，它的壳被石棱刮响
lines.en: While trailing you, its shell scrapes a stone edge.

lines.zh: 它固执地沿着同一条石缝前进
lines.en: It stubbornly follows the same crack the whole way.

lines.zh: 它用壳沿撞你的脚踝，轻得像碰
lines.en: It bumps your ankle with its rim, barely a tap.

lines.zh: 壳上的矿石磕在你腿上，叮一声
lines.en: The ore on its shell clinks against your leg.

lines.zh: 它甩了一下壳，把碎石子甩向你
lines.en: It flicks its shell, flinging grit at you.

lines.zh: 一下而已，随后它自己先退开了
lines.en: One hit only, and then it backs away first.

lines.zh: 这次撞击更像是在护住矿石
lines.en: The blow feels more like guarding its ore.

lines.zh: 它用软足拍了一下，力道很轻
lines.en: It slaps with its soft foot, without much force.

lines.zh: 壳沿刮过护腿，留下一道矿粉
lines.en: Its rim scrapes your greave, leaving a line of mineral dust.

lines.zh: 撞完它就缩回去，等着挨打
lines.en: After striking, it retracts and waits to be hit.

lines.zh: 它拿壳当锤子，笨拙地砸过来
lines.en: It swings its shell like a clumsy hammer.

lines.zh: 这一下没伤到你，倒把它自己晃晕
lines.en: The blow misses you and leaves it dizzy.

lines.zh: 无光的石面上，慢慢鼓出一个壳
lines.en: On lightless stone, a shell slowly swells upward.

lines.zh: 它从深板岩的裂缝里挤出来
lines.en: It squeezes out of a fissure in the deepslate.

lines.zh: 石头裂开，露出一枚带矿的壳
lines.en: The rock splits, revealing a mineral-studded shell.

lines.zh: 它第一次张开壳，露出一小段软足
lines.en: It opens for the first time, showing a bit of foot.

lines.zh: 洞里滴水的声音里多了点黏响
lines.en: Among the drips, a wet sticky sound joins in.

lines.zh: 一个新壳贴着凝灰岩长出绿宝石
lines.en: A new shell grows emeralds against the tuff.

lines.zh: 它缓慢转动，适应没光的洞穴
lines.en: It turns slowly, getting used to the dark cave.

lines.zh: 岩壁上的小鼓包忽然动了起来
lines.en: The little bump on the wall suddenly moves.

lines.zh: 一只矿壳贝在闪长岩上安了家
lines.en: A limpet settles onto the diorite as home.

lines.zh: 壳还软，它缩着等外壳变硬
lines.en: Its shell is still soft; it waits for it to harden.

lines.zh: 黑暗里亮起一点微弱的紫光
lines.en: A faint violet glow appears in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它在深板岩的层理间慢慢显形
lines.en: It fades into view between layers of deepslate.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，它慌不择路地挪开
lines.en: Its shell heats up and it scrambles away blindly.

lines.zh: 落地时壳磕出脆响，软足缩成一团
lines.en: It lands with a sharp crack, foot curled tight.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，它死死吸住石面
lines.en: Water floods its shell gap; it grips the stone hard.

lines.zh: 冲击把它的壳掀翻，露出软足
lines.en: The blast flips its shell and bares the soft foot.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，宝石被震得发抖
lines.en: An arrow sticks in its shell, and the gems shiver.

lines.zh: 魔力钻进壳缝，它整只僵住不动
lines.en: Magic seeps into the gap and it freezes stiff.

lines.zh: 石面苔被啃光，它的壳薄了一圈
lines.en: With the moss gone, its shell thins by a size.

lines.zh: 雷打中石头，它的壳边焦了一整圈
lines.en: Lightning strikes the rock and scorches its rim black.

lines.zh: 壳在虚空里失了重量，慢慢松开
lines.en: Weightless in the void, its shell slowly loosens.
